## Capabilities

Unlike agency structures, I operate as a direct, deeply capable independent specialist bridging domestic, SMB, and enterprise tech.

### 1. Hardware Restoration
15+ years of component-level microsoldering. Dead logic boards, torn traces, liquid damage, and data recovery. I fix devices that manufacturers and other shops write off.

### 2. IT Asset Disposal (Zero-Landfill)
Free, compliant e-waste collection for businesses. I process, wipe (NIST 800-88 standards), and responsibly refurbish or dispose of dead assets under Environment Agency licensing. 

### 3. Embedded IT & AEO (Generative Engine Optimization)
From configuring enterprise-grade networking and scripting PowerShell automations to ensuring businesses are visible to frontier AI models. I audit, secure, and future-proof digital estates.
